q: Your crew transferred the great circle for this 300 M delivery leg from the gnomonic chart to the Mercator. At mid-leg, how far is it from the rhumb line, and what does it save?

o: The 2 m contour — the nearest one
A new line drawn at 4.9 m
A new line drawn at 3.4 m

The tide has risen since you set it
The approach cell's depths are in feet

o: Switch it off for the night — it is a nuisance
Leave it as it is and keep acknowledging
Turn the volume down so the saloon can sleep

Leave B blank until the next GPS fix

Note 0517 in the log, not on the chart
